sm_top.sm: Ukraine's latest strike on the Crimea bridge led Russia to open a terrorism investigation into the incident.
A gas tanker was struck in the Strait of Hormuz, causing a fire and injuring or leaving crew members missing.
USS Theodore Roosevelt carrier strike group arrived in the Middle East as the third US carrier enforcing the Iran blockade.
U.S. forces conducted a strike on an IRGC missile site on Qeshm Island following Iranian attacks.
An Israeli airstrike in Gaza killed senior Hamas commander Samir Abu Younis.
Yemeni government forces withdrew from Bab al-Mandab to defend Aden against Houthi advances.
Iran conducted a drone strike targeting a US radar system at a Bahrain air base.
A tanker was struck by a projectile near Khasab, Oman.
Russian-appointed governor reports that the Crimean Bridge was attacked again, prompting traffic suspension.
Iranian drone strike killed six US service members at Ali Al Salem Air Base.
The Arab coalition destroyed a Houthi drone heading towards Riyadh.
Russian ballistic missile strikes hit Kyiv's Southern and Northern bridges, causing damage across districts.
Aerial attacks and hostile drones were intercepted by air defenses in Bahrain, Kuwait, and Saudi Arabia.
Iran launched drones targeting a US radar system at a Bahrain air base.
Israeli tanks entered central Gaza, crossing the ceasefire line in an offensive coordinated with the visiting US military commander.
Iran launched missile and drone attacks targeting U.S. military sites in Kuwait.
Houthi forces advanced to within 60 km of Aden, raising fears of a potential siege.
Iranian forces claim to have shot down a US drone south of Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz.
Yemen's Houthis claimed strikes on Riyadh's airport and financial center.
Saudi-backed forces launched a major attack against Houthi rebels in Yemen.
Polish authorities thwart a planned Russian false-flag attack near the border.
Hungarian rail services to Ukraine are suspended due to safety risks from Russian drone strikes.
Russian missile and drone strikes hit infrastructure in Kyiv, causing power outages and casualties.
Russia attacked Dnipro and the surrounding region nearly 20 times with missiles and drones.
An oil tanker was struck in the Strait of Hormuz, with the crew reported safe.
Iran's army announced it downed a US MQ-9 drone east of the Strait of Hormuz.
An airstrike on a displaced persons camp in Myanmar killed 12 people.
Mass Russian attacks injured more than 40 people in Dnipro and Zaporizhzhia.
Russian air defenses intercepted over 1,300 Ukrainian drones during a major large-scale aerial attack across multiple regions.
A Russian military transport plane crashed in Russia, resulting in 19 fatalities.
USS George Washington carrier strike group left the Persian Gulf region, likely returning to its home port in Japan.
Ukrainian drone and missile strikes hit and heavily damaged the Kerch Bridge linking Russia to Crimea.
Russian strikes on Odesa killed at least four people and injured several others.
Ukraine's Air Force reports air defenses intercepted Russian drones overnight.
The Yemeni army announced that 178 Houthi fighters were neutralized in recent ground fighting.
Ukrainian long-range drones struck a major petrochemical complex in Bashkortostan, Russia.
UN reported that drones caused most civilian deaths in Sudan in 2026.
Russian forces launched attacks on Zaporizhzhia, raising the casualty toll to 43.
Russian airstrike on a Komyshuvakha aid center killed 72 people, with search operations concluding.
The Saudi-led coalition destroyed a Houthi missile platform in Yemen.
